fields.Name: Configure Space Types
fields.Description: Configure space types and the collaboration app's settings.

fields.Name: Configure Spaces
fields.Description: Configure a space's settings, on spaces where the user's role allows configuring.

fields.Name: Close and Reopen Spaces
fields.Description: Close and reopen a space, on spaces where the user holds an owner seat. Granted apart from 'Configure Spaces', which changes a space's settings.

fields.Name: Administer Spaces
fields.Description: Administer spaces beyond an owner's rights: create a top-level space, move a space to the top level, change a space's allow-parent-assignees and agent-retrieval settings, give a task to someone seated above its space when the space doesn't allow it, and backdate a close.
